endpoint_definition: LoRA no-SAE accuracy minus LoRA plus generic ImageNet SAE accuracy, in percentage points; positive means generic-SAE intervention degradation.
model: Ordinary least squares with intercept, one untransformed predictor, and no holdout tuning.
current_training_note: Seven of fifteen planned development domains currently have paired outcomes (oxford_pets and pathmnist added 2026-07-24 via the ready-now eval_matrix run); FGVC is an auxiliary eighth domain not in the planned 15. Any fit to these eight is exploratory and is not the planned 15-domain confirmatory fit. pathmnist's eval split (7180 images, the medmnist_npz path's fixed official test split) is larger than the 225-image cap used for the imagefolder-type domains -- this makes its point estimate more precise, not biased, but technically departs from the fit's stated homoscedastic-residual assumption.
holdout_policy: Held-out outcomes must not occur in the fit input. Fit and freeze predictions before creating the holdout outcome CSV. Never choose the endpoint, transformation, or model family using these domains.
distance_feature_space: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 normalized image embeddings
distance_estimator: Unbiased RBF MMD squared with cross-distance median bandwidth, deterministic n=2000 subsamples and seed 42.
